$comment: Repo -> product spec mapping for scripts/import-specs.mjs. The board repo READMEs are the canonical spec source; this file says which repo feeds which variant of which product JSON. The FIRST variant listed for a product is the base: its README table becomes the shared `specs` array, the other variants become per-tier overrides. `root` is the container holding the board checkouts; OPENDRONE_HARDWARE overrides it so the mirror can be regenerated from any machine. OpenRX is deliberately absent: one repo, four boards, hand-maintained exception (maintainer, 2026-08-15).
